scenarios.name: sacrifice-creature-offers-one-mana-of-any-color
scenarios.why: 'Sacrifice a creature: Add one mana of any color' means the mana ability must offer every one of the five colors as a selectable output; sacrificing the Bears must put it in the graveyard. The full five-color offer is the Oracle-derived check; the harness cannot yet select a specific colour from a costed any-color ability, so the assertion is the offer set plus the cost payment.

scenarios.name: no-other-creature-no-offer
scenarios.why: With no other creature available the creature-sacrifice cost cannot be paid, so the mana ability is not offered.
